fact_english: The Palawan stink badger is not a true badger: it belongs to the skunk family.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang pantot ng Palawan, tinatawag na stink badger, hindi pala badger.

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Kamag-anak siya ng skunk. Kaya pala ganoon ang pangalan.

why_here: Usman's happy return closes the present-day opening (end of a script paragraph), and the next line jumps to Butuan in 1011. The gap is 80.600-81.427, so the break goes in at 81.01. Moved on 13 Nov for three reasons: the old cut split the bark from Usman's answer, the break would have shown chibi Usman before the story brings him back, and its insert_time of 79.17 fell inside his line.
